behavior: New enqueue, census seal/gap, direct seal and claimed completion preserve full source/decompiled strings with exact UTF-8 hashing; the legacy32KiB slicing threshold is never applied.

SpanCacheTextLimits validates UTF-8 field, combined batch bytes and actual write row budgets before text or compiler-state writes. Declared source_sha256 must match complete source bytes when new text is persisted.
Skipped/invalid/missing-ID rows and existing enqueue aliases do not consume new-write limits. Unknown nonpersisted gap payloads are not encoded/bound; historical gap counters remain compatible.

No automatic restoration, byte rewriting or rehashing of historical truncated rows. An explicitly supplied full source mismatching an old seal causes source_changed unsealing while retaining old bytes/hash.
Remote resume remains advisory-only; long full-source hashes match without adopting remote text, formulas, seals or claims.
Limits apply to persisted source/decompiled fields, not arbitrary rule payloads, input sequence preparation, Parquet expansion or guaranteed process RSS.
